title: Most Frequently Asked Questions — Chiang Mai Thailand by UTMB
publisher: UTMB World Series / HOKA Chiang Mai Thailand by UTMB
claims: The FAQ states that hot-weather and cold-weather kit decisions are made after assessing the latest conditions close to race day, possibly one or two days before the race.
The FAQ states that vehicles may enter the national park in accordance with Doi Inthanon National Park regulations.
The FAQ describes an Airport Line shuttle from Chiang Mai International Airport and Chiang Mai city at THB 400, and gives a call-centre number operating from 7 December, without stating a year.
The FAQ states that spectators may support runners only at designated aid stations and must present a Support Pass.
The FAQ states that mid-race baggage drop is available only for CHIANG DAO 160 and ELEPHANT 100, not for PAGODA 50.
The FAQ states that trekking poles are allowed but must be carried for the whole race and are not permitted in spare bags.
The FAQ states that a collapsible cup and a reusable bowl are different mandatory items and are not interchangeable.
The FAQ states that a power bank can replace headlamp batteries only within stated capacity conditions.
